title: MASSACRE PLANNING — STEP 1 / T0 NORMAL VILLAGE
time_of_day: Late afternoon approaching early evening; working choice, not locked canon

coordinate_system.up: map north = UE +X; no geographic north asserted
coordinate_system.height: UE Z metres; gate ground approximately 0

counting_rules: Approximate planning census of ordinary residents and estate occupants, not a locked canonical count.
Each person belongs to one P cluster at T0. Micro-groups are named subsets, never additional population.
Flows show ordinary next journeys during the evening transition, not simultaneous extra people, escape plans or exact schedules.
Witch and supernatural actors are outside this ordinary-population allocation; no position, action or route is assigned to them.
Animals and unoccupied future burial land are not counted.

population_clusters.name: Eastern fields / orchard
population_clusters.activity: Finish field rows, gather produce and stow hand tools.

population_clusters.name: Western field / pasture
population_clusters.activity: Finish agricultural work and settle livestock.

population_clusters.name: Eastern farm household
population_clusters.activity: Barn storage, food preparation, a child nearby and yard work.

population_clusters.name: Western farm household
population_clusters.activity: Unload tools and fodder; domestic work at the farmhouse.

population_clusters.name: Returning agricultural workers
population_clusters.activity: A loose returning stream, already on the approach; four going home, two to the tavern.

population_clusters.name: Lower households
population_clusters.activity: Supper preparation, washing, coop care and a parent with a child returning home.

population_clusters.name: Blacksmith
population_clusters.activity: Finish one wheel repair; put away tools and collect a repaired item.

population_clusters.name: Village centre
population_clusters.activity: Water collection, small transactions, conversation and through traffic across the junction and frontages.

population_clusters.name: Tavern
population_clusters.activity: Staff prepare for evening; early customers arrive while goods enter the service side.

population_clusters.name: Older residential pocket
population_clusters.activity: Families occupy five cottages, their back yards and the narrow passages.

distribution.activity: Shared yards including four children and a caregiver

population_clusters.name: Western household cluster
population_clusters.activity: Home life and small household trades, with firewood and washing brought in.

population_clusters.name: Middle / upper households
population_clusters.activity: Return to larger or less crowded homes; prepare supper and tidy gardens.

population_clusters.name: Church / public threshold
population_clusters.activity: One caretaker puts away the existing bucket and tends the public approach before closing.

population_clusters.name: Eastern edge households
population_clusters.activity: Feed animals and prepare food across the two edge cottages.

population_clusters.name: Forest working edge
population_clusters.activity: A small crew returns along the existing working trail with manageable cut wood and tools.

population_clusters.name: Mayor's property
population_clusters.activity: The Mayor is indoors; three guards perform routine property duties; four resident staff prepare evening service.

distribution.activity: Guards: entrance, service side and house duty

population_clusters.name: Estate-bound local delivery
population_clusters.activity: A local driver and helper take ordinary provisions up the cart road.

distribution.activity: Driver and helper already on the service climb

narrative_micro_groups.name: Handcart homeward
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: A farmer and helper bring a light handcart of produce/tools toward the lower households; they are part of the six returning workers.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Pasture gate
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: One keeper closes and checks the pasture gate after moving between pasture and farmyard; no open or abandoned enclosure is proposed.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Barn storage
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Two farm household workers put fodder and tools into the existing barn/storage area beside the cart.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Water collection
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Two neighbours fill containers, then take the existing streets toward their homes; part of the four well users.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Parent + child
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: A parent and child return from the village centre along Forge Lane toward the lower home and coop yard.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Tavern receiving
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Two tavern staff and the local delivery hand receive a barrel and food crates on the existing service side; one staff member remains on preparation duties.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Wheel repair
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Smith and apprentice finish a cart wheel at the existing wheel rack/worktable; work remains in progress normally.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Shared-yard neighbours
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Two neighbours talk beside shared storage while sorting household items, leaving the narrow passage clear.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Children in home yard
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Four children play a small quiet game beside the family table while a caregiver works nearby; the group stays off the road and cart access.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Firewood to supper
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: A resident takes a small armful from the existing firewood stack toward the household cooking area.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Woodcutters returning
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Three woodcutters carry tools and short cut wood along the working trail toward the western yards; no invented cart track through the trees.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Provisions uphill
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: Driver and helper use the established switchback and service opening for a normal provisions delivery. The formal staircase remains pedestrian access.

narrative_micro_groups.name: Caretaker closing
narrative_micro_groups.ordinary_activity: One caretaker finishes at the south public threshold, away from the disturbed graves; no congregation, funeral or major gathering.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Fields and approach to lower homes
ordinary_movement_flows.description: Four of P05 continue through the gate toward lower households. The arrow follows the road; final short household thresholds are not a navmesh claim.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Returning workers to tavern
ordinary_movement_flows.description: Two of P05 continue from the common approach/main road to the tavern porch; P09 is current occupancy and does not already include them.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Well to western homes
ordinary_movement_flows.description: Two water carriers leave the well via the civic frontage and existing street toward the western households.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Centre to older homes
ordinary_movement_flows.description: A few centre users return toward the older residential pocket along the existing road and passage.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Workshop to western home
ordinary_movement_flows.description: The assistant will head home once tools are put away. Smith and apprentice remain at the work location at T0.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Forest crew to western yards
ordinary_movement_flows.description: The three woodcutters are already returning; they rejoin the village through the existing short working trail.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Eastern field to barn
ordinary_movement_flows.description: Three long-field workers will take hand tools to the nearby barn by its existing field-access path. The arrow ends at the yard gate before the roof-obscured storage access; the other eastern agricultural workers finish separately.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Pasture to western farmyard
ordinary_movement_flows.description: Two pasture keepers return via the enclosure gate/access path after the evening livestock check.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Western field to barn storage
ordinary_movement_flows.description: Two of the four western field workers make a short storage trip; the other two continue finishing their work.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Local delivery to estate service access
ordinary_movement_flows.description: The existing cart route joins the main village road at its foot. The arrow begins at the delivery current position and follows the remaining switchback into service access, without using the stairs.

ordinary_movement_flows.name: Upper resident returning home
ordinary_movement_flows.description: One upper-household resident is on the last part of their ordinary walk home from the centre.

context_constraints.note: Both established story graves remain open and empty from the prior exhumation. No ordinary group is placed there; no mourning crowd or new burial is authored.
Preserve the domestic/herb-garden identity. The lover and child are not alive at T0; no normal family occupation or visitors are invented for this house.
Existing empty land remains unoccupied. No progression graves or activities assigned.

unresolved: Exact season, clock time, ages, household census and shift times remain working assumptions.
The compressed greybox fields are a village-edge agricultural sample, not an audited full food supply. No extra fields or residents have been invented beyond the map.
Interior activity is conceptual; roofs obscure rooms and doors. Some existing route centrelines overlap eaves or small proxies and need player-height clearance checks before implementation.
